text:
When a thermometer is calibrated, the fixed points are marked.
What are fixed points?
A
all the marks on the temperature scale which cannot be removed
B
all the marks of the temperature scale
C
the lowest and highest temperatures shown on the thermometer
D
two temperatures of known value which are easily reproduced

options.label: A
options.text: all the marks on the temperature scale which cannot be removed
